current_profile_snapshot.scope_note: Project common-practice tonal chamber baseline; not all Western classical music.
current_profile_snapshot.groove_behavior: meter hierarchy and phrase rhythm drive motion; no modern groove is imposed unless explicitly hybridized
current_profile_snapshot.phrase_behavior: balanced phrase structures with motivic development, cadence hierarchy and sectional contrast
current_profile_snapshot.harmony_behavior: common-practice tonal baseline with functional harmony and voice-leading; modal/modern classical requires another profile
current_profile_snapshot.bass_behavior: double bass/cello/bassoon or keyboard left hand support harmonic function rather than fixed groove
current_profile_snapshot.percussion_behavior_if_applicable: orchestral percussion optional and structurally motivated rather than constant
current_profile_snapshot.instrument_role_behavior: strings, winds, brass, keyboard and chamber combinations according to role; orchestration must respect instrument authority
current_profile_snapshot.ensemble_player_behavior: ensemble follows score-like dynamic/articulation relationships and shared rubato
current_profile_snapshot.arrangement_transformation: motivic development, register transfer, contrapuntal redistribution and formal return
current_profile_snapshot.dynamic_behavior: wide phrase-shaped dynamics including crescendos, diminuendos and terraced contrasts where appropriate
current_profile_snapshot.articulation_behavior: legato/staccato/tenuto/accent/bow/breath intent passed to instrument authority
current_profile_snapshot.timing_humanization_behavior: shared rubato at phrase/cadence level rather than random note displacement
current_profile_snapshot.continuous_performance_control: expression, breath/bow/pedal and tempo curves preserved
current_profile_snapshot.sound_effects_intent: naturalistic room/depth baseline; effects do not replace orchestration
current_profile_snapshot.production_mastering_intent: retain dynamic range; avoid overcompression and excessive brightness
current_profile_snapshot.manufacturer_adapter_requirements: target adapters must honor canonical orchestral identities and articulations
